message.content: {"question":"For the second law of thermodynamics (A) the efficiency of a thermal machine is independent of the substance that completes the cycle (B) the efficiency of a Carnot machine is as low as possible vice versa (C) all thermal machines have the same efficiency why do we need formulas then? the efficiency of a Carnot machine depends only on the temperature of the sources","options":{"A":"the efficiency of a thermal machine is independent of the substance that completes the cycle","B":"the efficiency of a Carnot machine is as low as possible vice versa","C":"all thermal machines have the same efficiency why do we need formulas then?","D":"the efficiency of a Carnot machine depends only on the temperature of the sources"},"correct":"D"}
